identity.name: De Ville Trésor
identity.one_liner: The 40mm De Ville Trésor in 18k yellow gold with the 8927 caliber — Omega's dress watch reference, the watch that competes with the JLC Master Ultra Thin in the $10,000-15,000 dress segment.

narrative.story: The De Ville Trésor is the 2014 dress watch that defined Omega's haute horlogerie direction. The 8927 caliber is a co-axial manual-wind movement with a 72-hour reserve and a Master Chronometer certification. The 40mm 18k yellow gold case is the classic De Ville proportion. The dial is sandwich-style with a small seconds at 6. The De Ville Trésor is the most-cited modern Omega dress watch and the watch a collector cites when arguing Omega has a haute horlogerie offering beyond the Constellation.
